title: EUREKA HYBRID04 RANDOM SCENES + STOCK MUTE CHORD FIX
author: analoglav
description: GH76 internal-sequencer Mute repair candidate: MIDI+YES is now one isolated chord. MIDI DOWN is temporarily deferred and is NOT forwarded to stock KEYDISP when followed by YES, so the original synth-track MUTE bank stays selected; solo MIDI and MIDI+TRACK are forwarded to the exact OS1.44 stock dispatcher with a matched MIDI DOWN/UP. Stock Mute, LED state, pattern/global Mute storage and FM audio are NOT overridden. 16 original 36-frame scenes randomly cut every 2-4 beats even in quiet parts; note-triggered 55% scene cuts, remaining speed/reverse/stutter. Video CC40,65,67,68,69 and 576 HYBRID04 frames unchanged. Requires on-device audio Mute verification; source-only, NOT YET BUILT.
